gen-dafont-nordic-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, with generous counters inside its a, e and s. But Nordic, the powerful, ancient heading, pinches its letters shut while drawing every stroke at a single monoweight.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-epunda-slab: Nulshock stretches wide and technical, with spacious tracking and a bold outline. Its monoline strokes make a loud statement, while Epunda Slab, a dignified serif with tall rounded lowercase, does the quiet explaining.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-suwannaphum: Nulshock spreads its bold technical letters wide, and its round forms carry walls just as strong as the straight ones. Suwannaphum, a dignified classic serif, lifts the pair with a tall, woodblock-square x-height.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height and a steady pen pressure, curves running smooth and unobstructed. Oldtimer stays moderate in height, giving that tallness a foil.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-hepta-slab: Round and stately: Oldtimer curls like open parentheses with no calligraphic swell, while Hepta Slab stretches every word out. One commands from the top; the other lets the text breathe.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-satoshi: Classic and commanding, Oldtimer rounds its forms like open parentheses, while Satoshi, a sans-serif, soars with a high x-height. Moderate height up top, a soaring lowercase beneath, and approachable ease between.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-bespoke-sans: Unique and contemporary, Origami paints single-stroke letters at constant width, with a lowercase mass like poured lead type. Bespoke Sans, sharp and refined, gives that weight room to breathe.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noticia-text: Origami writes like a sign-painter's brush, one constant stroke throughout. That brush look makes the statement, while Noticia Text, literary and dignified, settles in with curved entrances and tall lowercase bodies.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-bespoke-sans: Outrun Future traces wide-set letters in a constant-width outline you could follow with a finger. And Bespoke Sans, sharp and refined, reads smoothly, with generous room between curve ends and stems.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One is a literary serif with a tall middle band. Outrun Future makes the loud synthwave statement in a monotone outline, while Fauna One keeps its ascenders shallow and its reading dignified.
